correctness.rationale: For every canonical four-spine tuple (a,b,c,d), a,d≥2,b,c≥1, sum N≤200 and (a,b,c,d) lex≤(d,c,b,a), the color transfer weights w_s(j;z)=z^j(Σ_{h≠j}z^h)^{s−1} give exact P_T(z)=ps4(X_T) using 4-state recurrence. Modulo 2^64 reduction commutes with operations; equality of full polynomials would force identical pairs of residues at z=2,3. The pinned verify.cpp enumerates every canonical tuple and uses equality-aware hash map (not hash-only testing), zero collisions and total 31,060,953 types. Independently implemented a different backward-transfer exact mod-2^64 C++17 exhaustive checker across N=6..200; all 31,060,953 canonical classes counted and no identical residue pairs per N. No claim beyond N≤200. Burnside formula total (62,117,055+4,851)/2=31,060,953 independently agrees.

originality.rationale: Bingham et al. 2026 Conjecture 6.2 explicitly proposes ps4(X_T) separates all caterpillars; their Section 6 checked all caterpillars through 25 vertices and selective five-spine cases through 50. The complete four-spine N≤200 finite census with a two-residue deterministic separator is a strictly larger different finite domain not covered by inspected published checks. No claim of infinite separation.
residual_risks: Full result is a computational finite certificate with compiler/hardware dependence; independent second implementation reduces but does not eliminate this risk.
No conclusion for N>200 or spine lengths other than four. Historical priority remains qualified.
